## Evidence

Coolblue, Alternate Belgium, MediaMarkt Belgium and the structured LASystems specification table currently identify exact manufacturer code `9S7-265111-039` / EAN `4711377434980` as **Core Ultra 9 275HX**. Conflicting 290HX Plus claims persist in LASystems' commercial heading, 2Compute, Tweakers and an older Alternate URL. No exact Belgian MSI sheet is indexed, so the field remains `CONFLICT`; for purchasing, assume 275HX unless MSI confirms otherwise in writing.

Coolblue lists the exact AZERTY SKU at **€4199**, available for next-day delivery, with the charger explicitly included and two-year retailer defect handling. Adding the separately proven €162.62 Belgian MSI third-year service gives **€4361.62**, €82.55 below the €4444.17 ceiling. This route is operationally cleaner than LASystems plus a separately sourced adapter, but costs €64.26 more.

The Coolblue specification table also calls the panel IPS, conflicting with the exact-family OLED evidence. This is another reason not to purchase the 5090 SKU without written box/configuration confirmation.
